reason: The cited lines show schema validation, logging, a call to client.map with a user-supplied URL/options, and returning the result as text. They do not show arbitrary host code execution, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. The description says it returns matching URLs rather than page bodies, but the lines do not settle whether client.map can reach or return non-public/localhost/intranet data, so SECRET is insufficient. The call goes through client.map/Firecrawl rather than showing a direct request to an agent-chosen attacker-readable destination; the lines do not establish whether data is delivered to arbitrary hosts, so SINK is insufficient. Because the tool operates on arbitrary user-supplied web domains and returns URLs discovered from those sites, returned content can be controlled by an attacker who controls a target site, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
